Class SimulationEngineRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.SimulationEngineRegistry
public final class SimulationEngineRegistry extends Object
Central thread-safe registry and execution dispatcher for all SimulationEngineModule instances.

Completely decouples scenario execution and engine lifecycle management from hardcoded conditional chains. Enables seamless ablation studies and uniform resetting across runs.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
